unit: T4-U5b (explicit elastic tie rods, explicit_axial_rods_v1 with bilateral_linear)
status: Refuted on 2026-10-17 by a separate TASK that shares no code with the generator (a 100-digit 3D nodal solve with its own B and C, and hand free bodies in reduced coordinates), which confirmed every value. Its one MAJOR and four MINOR findings and HELP_HUMAN's two rulings of 2026-10-17 are applied in this revision. Confirmation of the repairs and the new cases is pending.
claim_fence: Standard claim fence applies (F-PIP-2; claims taxonomy per DEC-081).
basis: exact arithmetic over Q(pi) (rational functions of pi with rational coefficients, canonical); decimals are rounded from the exact forms at 40 significant digits, binary64 values from those; mill tolerance = corrosion allowance = 0; shear_model = euler_bernoulli
independence: generators/u5b_reference.py imports, reads and runs no product code or output; it reads t4_u5a's oracle.json and nine of its requests as data, bound by SHA-256
physics_source: JR CONTRACT.md sections 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 (J-C) and its independent refutation sections 2-4 (archived at 11718e61a2^); DEL-04-07 Design joint-pressure-thrust.md sections 1, 2, 4 and 9; HELP_HUMAN's rulings of 2026-10-17; re-derived here

1_non_parallel_rods.ruling: HELP_HUMAN, 2026-10-17: non-parallel rods are admitted; S_joint = Tb + sum T_r (n_r . Q_x) - Pe in every case; SK-F is an admitted reference case; section 9's former literal form Tb + sum T_r - Pe is the discriminator s_joint_section9_literal
1_non_parallel_rods.basis: section 9's hardware defines a general rod direction, e = n . (v_bj - v_bi); the literal form holds only when n . Q_x = 1 and breaks SK-F's interface identity by 28800/1661 N; the projected form is the face equilibrium and reduces to the literal form for parallel rods; refusing non-parallel rods would need a parallelism tolerance with no physical basis
1_non_parallel_rods.applied: every case's S_joint uses the projected rule; on every parallel case it equals the literal form exactly (checked); no value moved (SK-F's S_joint was already the projected 0)
1_non_parallel_rods.open: a rod nearly perpendicular to the joint axis (n . Q_x -> 0) is for the U5b implementation design to handle, with a named refusal if justified

2_p_zero_at_the_joint.ruling: HELP_HUMAN, 2026-10-17: rods are admitted on an unpressurized connector and on a constant-effective-area connector that no region lists; with p = 0 at the joint, Pe = 0 and the projected rule applies unchanged
2_p_zero_at_the_joint.basis: rods are hardware whose stiffness and reference extension act whatever the pressure; JR J-C's mechanical-only tied qualification is exactly this case
2_p_zero_at_the_joint.applied: controls MO-F, MO-T, RR-U and RR-P

criterion.rule: an entry passes when |obs - exp| <= 1e-9 * max(|exp|, F), F the floor of its family; both solver modes
criterion.unitless: direction components and n . Q_x: floor 1

sign_conventions.q: JR's symmetric-midpoint generalized deformation in connector axes (Q columns)
sign_conventions.g: elastic generalized action K (q - q_ref) only; rod forces are never in g
sign_conventions.rod_extension: e = n . (v_bj - v_bi), n = (b_j - b_i)/l, v_b = u + theta x offset; positive = longer
sign_conventions.rod_tension: T_r = k_r (e - e_ref), tension positive; e_ref < 0 is pretension
sign_conventions.rod_reference_load: +C^T k_r e_ref on the right-hand side
sign_conventions.rod_nodal_action: C^T T_r: the action of each node on the rod (node on element), global, moments about the node
sign_conventions.connector_endpoint: B^T g, node on element, global (as t4_u5a's endpoint rows)
sign_conventions.pipe_end_actions: K_e d - f_eq, node on element, global and member-local (x along the member, y = y_reference)
sign_conventions.S_joint: Tb + sum T_r (n_r . Q_x) - Pe in every case (HELP_HUMAN ruling 1, 2026-10-17); equal to Tb + sum T_r - Pe for parallel rods; Pe = 0 where the joint has p = 0 (ruling 2)
sign_conventions.Pe: p Ae at a joint a region lists; 0 for an unpressurized connector and for a constant-effective-area connector that no region lists
sign_conventions.Nw: pipe wall tension EA (eps - eps_T) + 2 nu Pi (Pi = 0 outside every region; eps_T only in MO-T)
sign_conventions.interface_identity: S_pipe = S_joint at both connector faces
sign_conventions.reactions: support on model, R = K u - f, moments about the support node
sign_conventions.pressure_rhs: pressure_rhs_global_n, t4_u5a's convention (its pressure_rhs.global_n; Design section 8 binds it to the product's assembled_pressure_rhs_global): representation B's physical caps at the region's transferring terminals, -/+ p(Ae - Ai) along Q_x at the end_i/end_j attachments of a joint the region lists, and every pressurized pipe's Poisson pair (+2 nu Pi at its node i, -2 nu Pi at its node j, along the member); rods, thermal eigenloads and applied loads are not pressure terms
sign_conventions.pressure_rhs_without_poisson_pairs: pressure_rhs_without_poisson_pairs_global_n: the same vector without the Poisson pairs (caps and joint pair only); the first freeze's pressure_rhs_global_n, kept under this name; no product field

rod_rigid_modes.result: C d = 0 exactly for all six infinitesimal rigid modes (three translations, three rotations about the arbitrary origin (7, -3, 5) m) of every rod in every case and of a generic skew rod with offsets at both ends

arm_sign_end_i_breaks_rigid_modes.meaning: a rod whose offset arm has the wrong sign at one end extends under rigid rotation

connector_B.result: B evaluated from JR's midpoint kinematics equals JR's printed B (identity and skew frames, offsets at both ends); q = 0 for all six rigid modes; the JR refutation's end actions and q for g = (2, -3, 5, 7, -11, 13) and d_k = (k - 4)/17 are reproduced exactly

generalized_basis.rule: for rods whose end nodes are the connector's (zero connector offsets), e = c . q with c = (Q^T n, Q^T(((o_i + o_j)/2) x n)); for a rod parallel to the axis at transverse offset (y, z) in connector axes c = (1, 0, 0, 0, z, -y), so k c c^T adds k to K_xx, k z^2 to K_ry, k y^2 to K_rz, and cross terms k z (x, ry), -k y (x, rz), -k y z (ry, rz) that cancel for a pair at +/-a
generalized_basis.pair_at_plus_minus_a_y: K_xx = 2 k_r, K_rz = 2 k_r a^2, all cross terms zero
generalized_basis.pair_at_plus_minus_a_z: K_xx = 2 k_r, K_ry = 2 k_r a^2, all cross terms zero
generalized_basis.four_rods: K_xx = 4 k_r, K_ry = K_rz = 2 k_r a^2: both relative bending rotations stiffened; K_rx unchanged (rods parallel to the axis add no torsional stiffness at first order)
generalized_basis.single_rod_at_plus_a_y: K_xx = k_r, K_rz = k_r a^2, K_x,rz = -k_r a: axial load couples into relative rotation
generalized_basis.checked: C = c B and B^T (sum k c c^T) B = sum C^T k C exactly for every layout below (a = 0.1 m, axial attachment offsets -/+0.05 m)

closed_form_identity.rule: every closed form above is checked against exact 3D stiffness solves at enough stiffness values to prove it an identity in the stiffness (the solves are rational with numerator degree <= rods + 1 and denominator degree <= rods; agreement at rods + 3 distinct values suffices): rows 2 and 4, with and without e_ref, correct and J4, at nine k_R values for the centreline rod and the pair; the single offset rod (with and without e_ref) and the offset-pair and four-rod relative rotations at seven k_r values; for p = 0 at the joint, MO-F's axial forms and relative rotation at seven k_r values for its pair, MO-T's forms (with and without e_ref) and the remote-region forms (unpressurized and unlisted constant-effective-area connector) at nine k_R values for the pair

invariance_control_centreline_vs_pair.rule: q, g, Tb, sum T_r, S_joint, every node translation and rotation, every reaction, the connector endpoint actions, Nw and every pipe end action are identical exactly; each rod of the pair carries sum T_r / 2. Only the rods' own nodal-action moments differ (the pair's offset arms)

j4_tied_control.statement: Double count (face caps dropped; the attachments carry -/+ p Ae). Anchored, at finite k_R: q_w - q = Pi/(k + k_R + kp/2), Nw_w - Nw = -Pi (kp/2)/(k + k_R + kp/2), R_A,w - R_A = -(R_D,w - R_D) = Pi (kp/2)/(k + k_R + kp/2) and sum T_w - sum T = Pi k_R/(k + k_R + kp/2); as k_R -> infinity q, Nw and the reactions coincide with the correct values while sum T_r -> 800 + 75 pi instead of 800 - 50 pi (wrong by exactly Pi). Free, at every k_R: Nw = Pi and the reactions (zero) are unchanged, q_w - q = Pi/(k + k_R), sum T_r -> Pe + Pi instead of Pe. In both chains S_pipe - S_joint = -Pi: the interface identity is broken at every k_R, including both limits

j4_double_count.mutant: JR J4: the joint face caps dropped, so the attachments carry -/+ p Ae instead of -/+ p(Ae - Ai) (terminal caps plus the full joint pair); formed only where a region lists the joint

rods_lumped_on_centreline.mutant: rod offsets ignored: each rod's attachments moved onto the connector centreline at its end nodes (o_i = o_j = 0), so the rod has no moment arm and its direction becomes (x_j - x_i)/|x_j - x_i| = Q_x; SK-F's rod direction (0.8, 0, 0.6) becomes Q_x = (1, 0, 0) and n . Q_x becomes 1

offset_sign_error.mutant: the rod offset arm with the wrong sign at both ends (v_b = u - theta x o): a mirror of every rod

arm_sign_end_i_only.mutant: the rod offset arm with the wrong sign at end i only (breaks the rigid modes)

e_ref_ignored.mutant: the reference extension ignored in both the reference load and the recovery (T = k e)

reference_load_sign_flipped.mutant: the reference load assembled as -C^T k e_ref; recovery T = k(e - e_ref) kept

reference_load_omitted.mutant: the reference load omitted; recovery T = k(e - e_ref) kept

rod_force_folded_into_g.mutant: rod forces folded into the connector's generalized action, g' = g + sum c_r T_r, and so into its elastic rows (g, Tb = g'_x and the endpoint rows B^T g'); S_joint then formed by the projected rule g'_x + sum T_r (n_r . Q_x) - Pe, which is g'_x + sum T_r - Pe for parallel rods and uses n . Q_x = 4/5 on SK-F

s_joint_without_rods.mutant: S_joint published as Tb - Pe (sum T_r left out)

ideal_in_place_of_finite.mutant: the k_R -> infinity (ideal tie) values published in place of the finite-rod values; scored only on q_x, g_x, Tb, sum T_r, S_joint, each rod's e and T_r, each pipe's Nw and S, the identity at both faces, every node translation and every reaction force (31 observables in L2-CL, 33 in L2-PR, 28 in L4-CL, 30 in L4-PR; per case scored_count); unmoved_count counts only those (16 anchored, 20 free)

s_joint_section9_literal.mutant: section 9's former literal rule S_joint = Tb + sum T_r - Pe (no projection) in place of the projected Tb + sum T_r (n_r . Q_x) - Pe (HELP_HUMAN ruling 1, 2026-10-17); identical for parallel rods, so formed only where a rod is not parallel (SK-F)
